subject: Obstruction - Northern Grand Banks
text:
Obstruction - Northern Grand Banks
ODAS mooring deployed at 47 50.843N, 46 51.329W . The ODAS buoy is a yellow spherical shaped buoy, measuring 0.9 meters in diameter, equipped with radar reflectors and a flashing light with characteristics flash yellow 5 times every 20 seconds. 
Wide berth requested.
Caution.
